about: How the parts in rig.json are stacked into Tamago. Used by scripts/pet/rig.gd (the pet) and service/web/js/portrait.js (dashboard portraits). Layers are drawn bottom to top: [name, part, bone, mirror about this canvas x (0 = no), squeeze x]. The far ear, arm, leg and eye are the near ones mirrored (the PSD has one of each) and tinted far_tint. Bones are in rig.gd.
